title: Keyblade Registry - Kingdom Hearts 0: Door to Darkness
note: The Twilight Keyblade is Zero's signature blade: the fusion of Oblivion and Oathkeeper, forged when light and dark chose the same wielder. It is an all-rounder - one of the best blades in the game - outclassed only in narrow niches by the keyblades of the other wielders, each tuned for a different character build. Keyblades are won by leveling and by defeating the 17 Shambler level bosses.

keyblades.name: Twilight Keyblade
keyblades.source: Oblivion + Oathkeeper, fully mixed into one blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Zero's own blade, held from the first keyhole. Light and dark refuse to part, and two halves of the same Keyblade were always one.
keyblades.desc: One blade, two heart-halves. Perfectly balanced strength and magic - the only weapon that can hold a door open from both sides at once.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key
keyblades.source: a splinter of the blade that closed the first Door
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Veska, the Erasure in Traverse Town - a splinter of the first Keyblade's light, prized from its cloak.
keyblades.desc: The classic keyblade. Sora's build: even spread, no weakness, endless heart.

keyblades.name: Way to the Dawn
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Throx, the Echo on the drowned isle - Soul Eater's dark successor, torn from the Echo's memory of Riku.
keyblades.desc: Riku's tank-brawler build: crushing strength and armor, magic sacrificed.

keyblades.name: Destiny's Embrace
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Yssora, the Tide in Atlantica - a princess's gift, thrown into the deep by the one who hates singing.
keyblades.desc: The support-mage build. Weak strikes, overwhelming healing and light magic.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key D
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Nox, the Hook in Neverland - the King's own blade, fished from the clockwork sea by the Hook's hand.
keyblades.desc: The speedster-light build. Quick strikes, fast dodges, clean light.

keyblades.name: Earthshaker
keyblades.source: the blade of the seeker of power
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat the Hinge That Opens in the Pride Lands - the heaviest blade, wedged in the Hinge's jaws mid-slam.
keyblades.desc: The heaviest build in the game: the highest strength and defense, at the cost of speed.

keyblades.name: Rainfell
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat the Page-Eater in the Hundred Acre Wood - Aqua's blade, dried ink-stained, recovered from the eaten chapter.
keyblades.desc: The pure-caster build. Magic outruns every melee, spells chain into spells.

keyblades.name: Wayward Wind
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Herrak, the Phantom in the Coliseum's phantom bracket - Ventus's blade, torn from the arena's ghost.
keyblades.desc: The crit-fisher build. Lowest defenses, highest speed, best critical rate.

keyblades.name: Bond of Flame
keyblades.source: a chakram thrown through a memory
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat the Organization's Eye in the Land of Dragons - a chakram of fire and fury, plucked from the Eye's stare.
keyblades.desc: The aggression build. Fire-charged combos that never seem to end.

keyblades.name: Two Become One
keyblades.source: the Nobody's blade - the mirror of Zero's own
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Zankor, the Vine in the Deep Jungle - Roxas's blade grown in the canopy, left for the only other unremembered.
keyblades.desc: Roxas's blade and Zero's shadow-sibling. The same twilight fusion, an inch behind in every stat.

keyblades.name: Ultima Weapon
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Grinx, the Grin in Halloween Town - the Heartless' own craft, half-forged in the second grin's cauldron.
keyblades.desc: The game's highest magic stat. A blade that is almost not a weapon.

keyblades.name: Oblivion
keyblades.source: the dark half of Zero's blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Mallos, the Hoard in the Cave of Wonders - the dark half of the Twilight Keyblade, dragged into the hoard.
keyblades.desc: A brutal dark-strength blade. Hits harder per swing and drinks enemy buffs to do it.

keyblades.name: Oathkeeper
keyblades.source: the light half of Zero's blade
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Qilra, the Trial in Wonderland - a promise kept on the forgetting-room, the light half of the Twilight Keyblade.
keyblades.desc: A radiant magic blade that shields the wielder as it casts.

keyblades.name: No Name
keyblades.source: the blade that watched a thousand wars
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat the Machine Heart in Hollow Bastion - Xehanort's blade, pulled from the machine's core: an old name, finally given.
keyblades.desc: The tactician build: every drive form drains slower, every dark spell hits harder.

keyblades.name: Keyblade of People's Hearts
keyblades.source: the blade that never was a heart
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Vurok, the Belly inside Monstro - a heart-shaped wound coughed up from the whale's memory.
keyblades.desc: A berserker's dark blade. The lower the HP, the more brutal the strikes.

keyblades.name: Kingdom Key (XI)
keyblades.source: a copy that grew a real heart
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat Saix, the Berserker rebuilt at Disney Castle - the copy that refused to be erased.
keyblades.desc: A perfect copy of the Kingdom Key - except it steals your memory-buffs and keeps them.

keyblades.name: Ultima Keyseal
keyblades.source: the final keyblade of the final door
keyblades.unlock_desc: Defeat the Shambler Archon at the World That Never Was - the game's ultimate reward, sealed at the end of the final door.
keyblades.desc: The strongest blade in the game, in every category, everywhere - the reason the final seven levels are worth the walk. There is no build this blade does not make stronger.
